name: Barbed Tail
text:
---
ancestry: devil
cost: 1 Point
name: Barbed Tail
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.devil/barbed-tail
type: trait
---

Your pointy tail allows you to punctuate all your actions. Once per round when you make a [melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), you can deal extra damage with the [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) equal to your highest [characteristic](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/characteristic) score.

text:
---
ancestry: devil
cost: 1 Point
name: Beast Legs
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.devil/beast-legs

Your powerful legs make you faster. You have [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) 6.

[Devil](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/ancestry/devil) heroes have access to the following traits.

#### Purchased Devil Traits

You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits. (*Quick Build:* Beast Legs, Impressive Horns.)

name: Glowing Eyes
text:
---
ancestry: devil
cost: 1 Point
name: Glowing Eyes
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.devil/glowing-eyes
type: trait
---

Your eyes are a solid, vibrant color that flares to show your excitement or rage. Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to deal that creature psychic damage equal to 1d10 + your level.

name: Hellsight
text:
---
ancestry: devil
cost: 1 Point
name: Hellsight
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.devil/hellsight
type: trait
---

Your eyes let you see through darkness, fog, and other obscuring effects. You don't take a [bane](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bane) on [strikes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) made against creatures with [concealment](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/concealment).

name: Impressive Horns
text:
---
ancestry: devil
cost: 2 Points
name: Impressive Horns
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.devil/impressive-horns
type: trait
---

Your cherished horns are larger than the average [devil's](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/ancestry/devil), and a hardened representation of your force of will. Whenever you make a [saving throw](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw), you succeed on a roll of 5 or higher.

name: Prehensile Tail
text:
---
ancestry: devil
cost: 2 Points
name: Prehensile Tail
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.devil/prehensile-tail
type: trait
---

Your prehensile tail allows you to challenge foes on all sides. You can't be flanked.

name: Signature Trait: Silver Tongue
text:
---
ancestry: devil
name: 'Signature Trait: Silver Tongue'
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.devil/silver-tongue
type: trait
---

Your innate magic allows you to twist how your words are perceived to get a better read on people and convince them to see things your way. You have one skill of your choice from the [interpersonal skill group](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.group/interpersonal) (see Skills in Chapter 9: [Tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/chapter/tests)), and you gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) when attempting to discover an [NPC](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/npc)'s motivations and pitfalls during a negotiation (see Chapter 11: [Negotiation](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/chapter/negotiation)).

name: Wings
text:
---
ancestry: devil
cost: 2 Points
name: Wings
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.devil/wings
type: trait
---

You possess wings powerful enough to take you airborne. While using your wings to [fly](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/fly), you can stay aloft for a number of rounds equal to your [Might](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/might) score (minimum 1 round) before you fall. While using your wings to [fly](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/fly) at 3rd level or lower, you have [damage weakness](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage-weakness) 5.

name: Draconian Guard
text:
---
ancestry: dragon-knight
cost: 1 Point
name: Draconian Guard
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.dragon-knight/draconian-guard
type: trait
---

Whenever you or an [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) creature takes damage from a [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), you can use a [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to guard against the blow. You reduce any damage from the [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) by an amount equal to your level.

name: Prismatic Scales
text:
---
ancestry: dragon-knight
cost: 1 Point
name: Prismatic Scales
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.dragon-knight/prismatic-scales
type: trait
---

Select one [damage immunity](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage-immunity) granted by your Wyrmplate trait. You always have this immunity, in addition to the immunity granted by Wyrmplate.

name: Remember Your Oath
text:
---
ancestry: dragon-knight
cost: 1 Point
name: Remember Your Oath
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.dragon-knight/remember-your-oath
type: trait
---

As a maneuver, you can recite the following oath. Until the start of your next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn), whenever you make a [saving throw](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw), you succeed on a 4 or higher.

*Even should the sun stop in the sky Even should the night last a thousand years I will stand forever I shall not yield Those who suffer and yearn for justice I am your sword and shield I will yield no ground I will speak no lies I will stand against all tyrants Until the last villain dies*

name: Signature Trait: Wyrmplate
text:
---
ancestry: dragon-knight
name: 'Signature Trait: Wyrmplate'
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.dragon-knight/wyrmplate
type: trait
---

Your hardened scales grant you [damage immunity](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage-immunity) equal to your level to one of the following [damage types](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage-type): acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, or poison. You can change your [damage immunity](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.damage/damage-immunity) type when you finish a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite).

name: Corruption Immunity
text:
---
ancestry: polder
cost: 1 Point
name: Corruption Immunity
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.polder/corruption-immunity
type: trait
---

Your innate [shadow](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/shadow) magic grants you resilience against the unnatural. You have corruption immunity equal to your level + 2.

text:
---
ancestry: polder
cost: 2 Points
name: Fearless
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.polder/fearless
type: trait
---

Courage is all you know. You can't be made [frightened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/frightened).

name: Graceful Retreat
text:
---
ancestry: polder
cost: 1 Point
name: Graceful Retreat
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.polder/graceful-retreat
type: trait
---

Your small [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) makes it easier for you to slip away from the fray. You gain a +1 [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to the [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) you can shift when you take the [Disengage](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.move-actions/disengage) move action.

name: Nimblestep
text:
---
ancestry: polder
cost: 2 Points
name: Nimblestep
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.polder/nimblestep
type: trait
---

A light step serves you well when [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) is of the essence. You ignore the effects of [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain) and can move at full [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) while sneaking.

name: Polder Geist
text:
---
ancestry: polder
cost: 1 Point
name: Polder Geist
scc: mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.trait.polder/polder-geist
type: trait
---

Evading others' notice gives you freedom to move. At the start of each of your [turns](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) during combat, if no enemy has [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to you or if you are hidden from or have [concealment](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/concealment) from any enemy with [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to you, you gain a +3 [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to [speed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/speed) until the end of your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn).
